alex: Quick heads up — trying to model a canary+ab flow in the Console. Wanted feedback on routing guard semantics.

 tara: Nice. Do you mean the guard that prevents >X% traffic to unvalidated variants?

 alex: Kinda. Two questions: 1) should the console enforce a global per-experiment QPS cap that sits above per-variant quotas? 2) how should we handle automatic fallback when a variant hits its quota — immediate reroute vs drain?

 ben: For 1) global cap makes sense for infra protection. But it complicates telemetry math. If you cap at experiment-level, per-variant SLI computation needs to subtract capped requests.

 sophie: agree w/ben. Also UX: show a live indicator when global cap is active — red badge on experiment details.

 alex: ok. Proposal: routing precedence: explicit rule (variant match) -> variant quota check -> global cap check -> fallback routing. If fallback, route to control variant if present else last-stable. Thoughts?

 tara: That's sensible. Edge — what if fallback pushes control over its quota? We could try an ordered fallback chain across variants.

 ben: I'd rather not do cascade fallback that could cause thrash. Simpler: fallback to 'service-level' default route and mark experiment paused. We need alerting + automatic pause when fallback rate > 5% for 60s.

 sophie: UX suggestion: warn during creation if control capacity is less than sum of fallbacks. And provide 'reserve buffer' param.

 alex: Telemetry needs: per-variant request_count, dropped_count (due to quota), fallback_count, avg_latency, error_rate and a derived 'fallback_ratio'. Also capture reason code: "quota", "global_cap", "routing_error".

 ci-bot: deploy-bot: experiment/validation:1 started

 tara: API debate: do we return 200+meta indicating routed_variant or HTTP 4xx for "dropped"? Ben?

 ben: Return 200 with metadata. Treat drop as successful routing to fallback/control — downstream expects a result. But expose status flags in headers/response object so SDKs can surface it.

 alex: example response snippet:
 ```json
 {"variant":"canary-b","fallback":"control","fallback_reason":"quota","flags":{"dropped":true}}
 ```

 tara: On Console side, creation flow changes: add 'critical capacity' screen that shows projected per-variant TPS and highlights shortfalls. Inline link: /docs/rollouts/capacity-guidance

 sophie: Accessibility: default seeds should be explicit numbers not sliders. Sliders hide exactness.

 alex: Ok next steps: ben to draft API shape for routing metadata, tara to mock console warning UI, sophie to write telemetry schema, I'll wire experiment-level pause rules. Ping here when drafts are ready.

 tara: +1

 ben: I'll post a PR with the API schema later today. :thumbsup:

 sophie: I'll add telemetry protos and an example grafana panel

 alex: Thanks all. CI bot: experiment/validation:1 succeeded
